title: 第一百五十八章 真相大白封官进爵结局第一百五十七章 剑出深渊身份揭开
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 当朝天子，身着一袭明黄色的常服，正亲自为贾环斟上一杯热茶。他的面容沉静，但眼底深处，却有雷霆在酝酿。
“贾环，朕让你查的事情，有结果了。”天子的声音不大，却带着不容置疑的威严。
贾环躬身接过茶杯，沉声道：“幸不辱命。所有证据，皆已在此。”
他从怀中取出一个油布包裹的铁盒，双手奉上。
盒中，是裕王与王子腾多年来勾结，意图不轨的往来密信。
天子打开铁盒，仔细看过那份供状后，长长地吐出了一口气。他闭上眼睛，再睁开时，所有的犹豫和隐忍都已消失不见，取而代之的，是前所未有的决绝与锋芒。
“十七年了……”他喃喃自语，眼中闪过一丝刻骨的悲痛与愤怒，“朕的父皇，竟被奸人囚禁，让一个冒名顶替的乱臣贼子，在太上皇的位子上坐了十七年！国之大耻，莫过于此！”
贾环静立一旁，默然不语。
“王子腾，是那假太上皇一手扶植起来的爪牙。裕王，不过是他们推到台前的棋子。”天子看向贾环，目光灼灼，“朕现在给你一道密旨，调动禁军‘龙骧卫’三百，即刻前往京营节度使府，将王子腾拿下！朕要让他，为这十七年的罪孽，付出代价！”
“臣，遵旨！”贾环单膝跪地，声音铿锵。
当他再次站起身时，整个人的气势已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
如果说之前的贾环是一柄藏于鞘中的利剑，那么此刻，他就是一头挣脱了所有枷锁的洪荒巨兽。
就在昨夜，与古月前辈那场生死一线的对决中，在巨大的压力之下，贾环体内的真气冲破了最后的壁障。
龙象般若功，第十三层，大圆满！
如今的他，举手投足间，便有十三龙十三象的无上伟力。这股力量，足以让他藐视任何招式与技巧。
京营节度使府，位列朱雀大街，门前石狮高耸，卫兵林立，气派非凡。
王子腾此刻正坐在书房的太师椅上，烦躁地揉着眉心。他派出去的血剑骑士，如泥牛入海，杳无音信。全城大索，也未能找到贾环的半点踪迹。这让他心中升起一股强烈的不安，仿佛有一张看不见的大网，正在缓缓收紧。
就在这时，府外突然传来一阵巨大的喧哗声和兵刃交击声。
“怎么回事？”王子腾厉声喝问。
一个亲信连滚爬爬地冲了进来，脸色惨白如纸：“侯爷，不好了！禁军……神枢营把我们给围了！带头的是……是贾环！”
“什么？”王子腾霍然起身，满脸的难以置信。
他快步冲出书房，只见府邸之内，已是一片混乱。三百名身着黑色甲胄、杀气腾腾的龙骧卫，如虎入羊群，他那些平日里耀武扬威的亲兵，在这些真正从尸山血海里爬出来的精锐面前，根本不堪一击。
而在那片混乱的中心，一个熟悉而又陌生的身影，正一步步向他走来。
贾环。
“贾环！你好大的胆子！竟敢率兵冲击朝廷命官的府邸！你想谋反吗？”王子腾色厉内荏地吼道，同时暗自运起了全身的功力。他也是沙场宿将，武功早已臻至一流高手之境，他不信自己会输给一个黄口小儿。
贾环停下脚步，看着这个害死自己姑父一家，又数次想置自己于死地的仇人，眼神平静得可怕。
“王子腾，奉陛下密旨，前来拿你归案。”
“一派胡言！我看你是假传圣旨！”王子腾怒喝一声，不再废话。他猛地一跺脚，身形如大鹏展翅，凌空扑向贾环，双掌推出，带着撕裂空气的厉啸。这是他的成名绝技“裂山掌”，掌力雄浑，开碑裂石不在话下。
面对这雷霆万钧的一击，贾环甚至连眼皮都没有抬一下。
他只是简简单单地，抬起右手，迎着王子腾的双掌，一拳轰出。
这一拳，没有任何花哨的招式。
但在王子腾的眼中，他看到的却不是一个拳头。他看到的，是十三头远古巨龙的咆哮，是十三头洪荒神象的奔踏！那股毁天灭地的力量，让他引以为傲的掌力，瞬间土崩瓦解，如同纸糊的一般。
content_en:
The emperor of the day, dressed in bright yellow uniform, was personally pouring a cup of hot tea for Jia Huan. His face was calm, but deep in his eyes, there was thunder brewing.
"Jia Huan, the matter I asked you to investigate has come to fruition." The emperor's voice was not loud, but it carried unquestionable majesty.
Jia Huan bowed and took the tea cup, and said solemnly: "Thank you for your honor. All the evidence is here."
He took out an iron box wrapped in oilcloth from his arms and held it up with both hands.
In the box, there are secret letters between King Yu and Wang Ziteng who have been colluding for many years with evil intentions.
The emperor opened the iron box, read the confession carefully, and let out a long breath. He closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, all the hesitation and forbearance had disappeared, replaced by unprecedented determination and sharpness.
"Seventeen years..." He murmured to himself, with a trace of deep sorrow and anger flashing in his eyes, "My father was imprisoned by a traitor, and an imposter and traitor was allowed to sit on the throne of the Supreme Emperor for seventeen years! The greatest shame of the country is nothing more than this!"
Jia Huan stood aside quietly, silent.
"Wang Ziteng is the minion supported by the fake Supreme Emperor. Prince Yu is just a pawn that they pushed to the stage." The emperor looked at Jia Huan, his eyes blazing, "I will give you a secret order now, mobilize three hundred of the imperial army's 'Longxiang Guards', and immediately go to the Jiedu Envoy's Mansion in Beijing to capture Wang Ziteng! I will make him pay for the sins of these seventeen years!"
"My lord, I obey the order!" Jia Huan knelt down on one knee, his voice sonorous.
When he stood up again, his whole demeanor had undergone earth-shaking changes.
If Jia Huan before was a sharp sword hidden in a sheath, then at this moment, he is a giant beast that has broken free of all shackles.
Just last night, in the life-and-death showdown with Senior Gu Yue, under the tremendous pressure, the true energy in Jia Huan's body broke through the last barrier.
Dragon Elephant Prajna Gong, thirteenth level, Dzogchen!
Now, he has the supreme power of thirteen dragons and thirteen elephants in every move he makes. This power is enough to make him defy any moves or techniques.
The Jingying Jiedushi Mansion is located on Zhuque Street. In front of the gate are towering stone lions and numerous guards. It is of extraordinary magnificence.
Wang Ziteng was sitting on the master's chair in the study, rubbing his brows irritably. The blood sword knights he sent out were like mud cows drowning in the sea, and there was no news. Searches throughout the city failed to find any trace of Jia Huan. This made him feel a strong sense of uneasiness, as if there was an invisible net that was slowly tightening.
At this moment, there was a sudden loud noise and the sound of weapons clashing outside the house.
"What's going on?" Wang Ziteng asked sharply.
A confidant rushed in, his face as pale as a sheet of paper: "Master Marquis, it's not good! The Forbidden Army... Shenshu Camp has surrounded us! The leader is... Jia Huan!"
"What?" Wang Ziteng stood up suddenly, his face full of disbelief.
He rushed out of the study room quickly and saw that the mansion was in chaos. Three hundred Long Xiang guards, dressed in black armor and full of murderous intent, were like tigers entering a flock of sheep. His soldiers who usually showed off their power were completely vulnerable to these elites who had truly crawled out of the sea of ​​​​blood from the mountain of corpses.
And in the center of the chaos, a familiar yet unfamiliar figure was walking towards him step by step.
Jia Huan.
"Jia Huan! You are so brave! How dare you lead your troops to attack the palace of the imperial official! Do you want to rebel?" The prince shouted with anger, while secretly using all his strength. He is also a veteran on the battlefield, and his martial arts has already reached the level of a first-class master. He does not believe that he will lose to a child with a yellow mouth.
Jia Huan stopped and looked at the enemy who had killed his uncle's family and tried to kill himself several times, his eyes were terrifyingly calm.
"Prince Teng, according to His Majesty's secret order, came to bring you to justice."
"What nonsense! I think you are pretending to pass on the imperial edict!" Wang Ziteng shouted angrily and stopped talking nonsense. He stamped his feet suddenly, like a roc spreading its wings, and flew towards Jia Huan in the air. He pushed out with both palms and roared loudly as it tore the air. This is his famous stunt "Mountain Splitting Palm". The palm power is so powerful that it can easily crack monuments and rocks.
Facing this thundering blow, Jia Huan didn't even raise his eyelids.
He simply raised his right hand, met Wang Ziteng's palms, and punched out.
There are no fancy moves in this punch.
But in Wang Ziteng's eyes, what he saw was not a fist. What he saw was the roar of thirteen ancient dragons and the running of thirteen ancient elephants! That power that destroyed the world and destroyed the earth made the palm power that he was so proud of instantly fall apart, like paper.
title_en: Chapter 158: The truth is revealed. The ending of becoming an official. Chapter 157: The sword emerges from the abyss and the identity is revealed.
